title: Gambling Is Under a Quarter of MGM's Vegas Money #shorts
summary: At MGM's Las Vegas Strip resorts in 2025, casino revenue was $2.0B of $8.4B (24%); rooms brought $2.9B and food and drink $2.3B.
sources: MGM Resorts International 2025 Form 10-K, segment revenue (XBRL R88), Las Vegas Strip Resorts net revenue 2025: casino $2,013,701K; total $8,441,503K; rooms, food and beverage, entertainment/retail/other make up the rest (34.1%, 26.8%, 15.2%): https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/789570/000078957026000018/R88.htm

MGM Resorts 2025 Form 10-K: "Over half of the net revenue from our Las Vegas Strip Resorts is typically derived from non-gaming operations.": https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/789570/000078957026000018/mgm-20251231.htm
Our math: slots share of Nevada win 10,713.8 / 15,798.5 = 67.8%; MGM Strip casino share 2,013.7 / 8,441.5 = 23.9%; $100 x 5.26% = about $5.

scenes.narration: Less than a quarter of MGM's Las Vegas Strip money came from gambling last year.
Rooms brought in more. So did food and drink.
MGM's own report says over half of its Strip revenue typically isn't gaming.
The casino brings the crowd. The building does the rest.
